verbatim_critique:
[D0.5.G cold referee] delivered tier=subfield below novelty_target=field (floor=field). The note proves a correct fixed-propensity convex-generator iff, stable binary counterexamples, and exact mixture/CDF formulas for a two-vertex bow model. It does not prove the corresponding equality on the published covariate-conditioned SCM class with one globally compatible structural model across all covariate values; the latent construction is performed separately for a fixed stratum and may vary arbitrarily with the target law. Consequently, the repeated description of the result as a “flagship” causal frontier overstates what is settled: the delivered contribution is a narrow pointwise probability-law characterization rather than a full correction of the published conditional framework. The simultaneous band is distribution-free only for the unconditional fixed-stratum arm CDF and does not close that scope gap.

DIRECTED IMPROVEMENT (re-derive the SAME object implementing this, do not reproduce the prior note): Extend the fixed-stratum characterization to the published covariate-indexed model and establish joint cross-stratum realization and exactness for the propensity-adaptive hinge family. This would turn the current pointwise analogue into a correction of the published causal ambiguity class itself.
